subject: Capacity calibration call — Dedicated throughput demo (PrimeHealth)
messages:
From: Sophia Lim <sophia@primehealth.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for clinical scheduling

Hi Rishi,

We signed up via your self-serve flow and ran some initial tests with the hosted API — promising results. We're evaluating Redwood Dedicated because we need predictable throughput for a clinical scheduling flow used by our patient call center. High level: about 250 inference requests/second at peak (bursts to ~400), average request size ~120 tokens, and 95th-percentile token latency needs to stay under ~150ms per token (end-to-end requirements might be higher — happy to walk through).

I've attached a brief capacity spreadsheet with our traffic windows and a sample prompt set. We'd like a short technical demo focused on Dedicated capacity: how you size pools, autoscaling behavior under bursty traffic, and how caching/batching will affect our per-token latency and cost.

Availability this week: Mon/Wed 10am–2pm PT, Tue/Thu 12pm–4pm PT. If you have a runbook or anything to review ahead of time, please send it.

Thanks,
Sophia Lim
Head of Platform
PrimeHealth Solutions
Attachment: primehealth_capacity_requirements.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Lim <sophia@primehealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for clinical scheduling

Hi Sophia — great to meet you over email and thanks for the detailed spreadsheet. Monica (Solutions Eng) and Marissa (Dedicated PM) are looped in — Monica will lead the throughput/latency deep-dive.

Suggested next steps / agenda (30–45 min):
- Quick intro + goals (5 min)
- Walk through your traffic windows and sample prompts (5–10 min)
- Live demo: Dedicated pool sizing, autoscaling under burst, KV/prefix caching behavior, and quantization trade-offs (20 min)
- Q&A + next steps (5–10 min)

Available slots (PT): Fri 12/4 10:30–11:15, Mon 12/7 11:00–11:45, Tue 12/8 13:00–13:45. Or you can pick a slot on our scheduling page: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/capacity-calibration-30m.

Prep: please keep the capacity spreadsheet handy — Monica may ask for a couple of representative prompt examples and typical max tokens per request. We'll bring a short runbook and a sample shaping policy we use for similar customers.

If you need an earlier/flexible time, tell us your preferred timezone and I'll coordinate.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Sophia Lim <sophia@primehealth.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 12:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request — Demo time

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — we can do Fri 12/4 but the 10:30 PT slot conflicts with a scheduling blackout here. Could we shift to 11:00 PT / 2:00 ET on Friday? That works for our platform engineering lead (I'll forward a calendar invite once confirmed).

A couple quick notes:
- The peak bursts are event-driven and last ~20–40s; we'd like to see how autoscaling reacts to sub-minute bursts.
- We also want to validate TLS termination and KMS integration for keys at rest.

I'll attach a sample prompt set in my next email.

Best,
Sophia

Hi Sophia — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET on Fri 12/4 works for us. I've scheduled a 30-minute session and set the agenda to the items below. Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/meet-link-placeholder

Agenda (30m):

Looking forward to it — see you Friday.
